name: The Four Seasons
description: The decades-long friendship between three married couples is tested when one divorces, complicating their tradition of quarterly weekend getaways.

videos.title: Lake House
videos.overview: Nick and Anne welcome longtime friends Kate, Jack, Danny and Claude for a weekend at their bucolic lake house — where some very unwelcome news awaits.

videos.title: Garden Party
videos.overview: Reeling from Nick's confession, the other couples must decide whether to reveal the truth to Anne before she suffers a public embarrassment.

videos.title: Eco Resort
videos.overview: Months later, the friends reunite at a tropical resort, where a new addition complicates the group dynamic.

videos.title: Beach Bar
videos.overview: Hoping to warm up to Ginny, the gang hits a late-night beach party, where tequila-fueled conflict ensues. Anne is tempted by forbidden fruit.

videos.title: Family Weekend
videos.overview: Fall has arrived as the group reunites at Jack, Kate and Danny's alma mater. An attempt to spice things up leads to friction between Danny and Claude.

videos.title: Ultimate Frisbee
videos.overview: Jack and Kate try to rekindle the romance of their college years, with mixed results. Nick comes face-to-face with Lila's anger about the divorce.

videos.title: Ski Trip
videos.overview: It's Nick's turn to be on the outs as Anne joins the other couples for a New Year's ski vacation — and he struggles to fit in with Ginny's friends.

videos.title: Fun
videos.overview: A twist of fate forces Anne and Ginny to confront their complicated feelings about one another. Jack and Kate's standoff comes to a head.

videos.title: Hiking
videos.overview: A trip upstate to spread Nick's ashes on a mountaintop becomes an uphill battle as tensions climb between Anne and Ginny.

videos.title: Funky Motel
videos.overview: On lockdown at an understocked motel, Danny and Claude reopen an old conversation, Jack gets hangry and Anne shares what's eating her.

videos.title: Down the Shore
videos.overview: The group unwinds at the beach, but Kate and Jack aren't on the same wavelength. A recent arrival turns the tide in Ginny and Anne's relationship.

videos.title: On the Boardwalk
videos.overview: A stunning admission from Claude leaves Danny spiraling. Anne lets loose with a casual summer fling. Kate gives Jack's secret coping mechanism a spin.

videos.title: Big Thanksgiving
videos.overview: Danny and Claude dish out big news at an overstuffed Thanksgiving gathering. Jack and Kate "hack marriage" by each doing their own thing.

videos.title: Little Thanksgiving
videos.overview: Anne flashes back to the pandemic, when the group got together for a not-so-socially distanced Thanksgiving — and she arrived at a personal crossroads.

videos.title: Trento
videos.overview: Kate gives Danny the cold shoulder on a visit to the Italian Alps. Anne's resemblance to a Christmas witch leaves her questioning her life choices.

videos.title: Maratona
videos.overview: With Jack down in the dumps, Kate pressures him to hit the ground running. Danny and Claude's relationship faces a new test.
